name: Touko Takatsukasa
source:
Likes: Basketball, working out, relaxing, milkshakes
Dislikes: Laziness

Star of the basketball team, Touko is a girl with an aloof, cool, and somewhat detached attitude. She has a very dry sense of humor, tending to be sarcastic. Touko's best friends are Aina and Satsuki, tending to hang around with either or both when she's not playing or trying to engage in her studies. Touko finds Shinn to be "interesting", and senses he has more interests in the academy than just mere tutoring.
